q1.explanationZh: loose 形容词“松的；松散的”，注意与动词 lose“丢失”区分（loose 有两个 o）。

q2.explanationZh: loose 加 -en 构成动词 loosen“松开；变松”。

q3.explanationZh: lorry 是英式英语的“卡车”，美式常用 truck。

q4.explanationZh: lose“失去；输掉”，过去式和过去分词是 lost。

q5.explanationZh: loss 是 lose 的名词形式“损失；丢失”。

q6.explanationZh: lot 名词“大量”，常用 a lot of / lots of；a lot 作副词表示“非常；常常”。

q7.explanationZh: loud 既是形容词也是副词“大声的；大声地”，另有副词 loudly。

q8.explanationZh: love 动词、名词同形，“爱；喜欢”。

q9.explanationZh: lovely 虽以 -ly 结尾，却是形容词“可爱的”。

q10.explanationZh: loving 形容词“表示爱的；钟爱的”，如 peace-loving“热爱和平的”。

q11.explanationZh: low 形容词“低的；矮的”，反义词是 high。

q12.explanationZh: lower 作及物动词“放低；降低”，如 lower the price。

q13.explanationZh: loyal 形容词“忠诚的”，常用 be loyal to。

q14.explanationZh: loyal 加 -ty 构成名词 loyalty“忠诚”。

q15.explanationZh: luck 名词“运气”，Good luck!“祝你好运！”。

q16.explanationZh: luck 加 -y 构成形容词 lucky“幸运的”。

q17.explanationZh: luggage“行李”是不可数名词，“一件行李”说 a piece of luggage。

q18.explanationZh: lunar 形容词“月球的”，lunar calendar“农历”。

q19.explanationZh: lunch“午餐”，have lunch 前一般不加冠词。

q20.explanationZh: lung 名词“肺”，人有两个肺，常用复数 lungs。

q21.explanationZh: luxury 名词“奢侈（品）”，形容词是 luxurious。

q22.explanationZh: machine 可数名词“机器”，注意拼写 ch 读 /ʃ/。

q23.explanationZh: machinery 是机器的总称，不可数名词。

q24.explanationZh: mad 形容词“疯的；狂热的”，drive sb. mad“使某人发疯”。

q25.explanationZh: madam 是对女性的尊称“夫人；女士”。

q26.explanationZh: magazine“杂志”，重音在最后一个音节。

q27.explanationZh: magic 可作名词“魔法；魔术”，也可作形容词“有魔力的”。

q28.explanationZh: magic 加 -al 构成形容词 magical“有魔力的；神秘的”。

q29.explanationZh: magnificent 形容词“壮丽的；宏伟的”，名词是 magnificence。

q31.explanationZh: mail 名词“邮件”，动词“邮寄”，相当于英式的 post。

q32.explanationZh: main 形容词“主要的”，只作定语，副词是 mainly。

q33.explanationZh: main + land 构成 mainland“大陆”。

q34.explanationZh: at a loss“茫然不知所措”，loss 前用不定冠词 a。

q35.explanationZh: a lot 作副词“很，非常”，可修饰比较级，如 a lot better。

q36.explanationZh: lose heart“失去信心”，heart 前不加冠词。

q37.explanationZh: fall in love with sb.“爱上某人”，介词用 with。

q38.explanationZh: be mad for“渴望；对……发狂”，介词用 for。

q39.explanationZh: cast loving glances“传送秋波”，loving 修饰 glances。

q40.explanationZh: 谚语 Love me, love my dog.“爱屋及乌”。

q41.explanationZh: be loyal to“对……忠诚”，to 是介词。

q42.explanationZh: pack up“打包”，luggage 是不可数名词。

q43.explanationZh: drive sb. mad“使某人发疯”，mad 作宾语补足语。

q44.explanationZh: the main idea of...“……的主要意思”，main 作定语。

q45.explanationZh: mail 作动词可接双宾语：mail sb. sth.“给某人寄某物”。

q46.explanationZh: show one’s loyalty to...“向……表示忠诚”，loyalty 是名词。

q47.explanationZh: low 的比较级 lower，“比……低”= be lower than。

q48.explanationZh: show love to sb.“向某人示爱”，love 在这里是名词。

q49.explanationZh: “散装的，不是盒装的”，用形容词 loose 作补语。

q50.explanationZh: fall in love with“爱上”，固定搭配。

q51.explanationZh: 冠词 the 后用名词，“丢车的事”用 loss。

q52.explanationZh: 修饰名词 dogs 用形容词 lovely“可爱的”。

q53.explanationZh: “吸烟伤肺”，人有两个肺，用复数 lungs。

q54.explanationZh: live in luxury“过着奢侈的生活”，介词 in 后用名词 luxury。

q55.explanationZh: lots of“许多”，位于句首首字母大写。

q56.explanationZh: 主语后缺谓语，用动词 lower“降低”，主语是复数，用原形。

q57.explanationZh: agricultural machinery“农用机械”，machinery 是不可数名词。

q58.explanationZh: 修饰名词 scene 用形容词 magnificent“壮丽的”。

q59.sampleAnswer: Every Wednesday afternoon, each class takes turns to look after the school garden, where students loosen the soil, water the plants, and feel both the joy of labour and the power of cooperation in the process of sweating.
references: Every Wednesday afternoon, each class takes turns to look after the school garden, where students loosen the soil, water the plants, and feel both the joy of labour and the power of cooperation in the process of sweating.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “轮流做某事”= take turns to do sth.；“松土”= loosen the soil；where 引导定语从句修饰 garden。

q60.sampleAnswer: Pay compliments to those you love and care for before it is too late.
references: Pay compliments to those you love and care for before it is too late.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “赞美”= pay compliments to；“趁还来得及”= before it is too late；those you love 省略了关系代词。

q61.sampleAnswer: I used to believe my mother had magical powers.
references: I used to believe my mother had magical powers.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “以前一直”用 used to do；“魔力”= magical powers。

q62.sampleAnswer: Despite the fact that he had been there many times, he still lost his way.
references: Despite the fact that he had been there many times, he still lost his way.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “尽管”= despite the fact that...，不能再用 but；“多次”= many times；“迷路”= lose one’s way。

q63.sampleAnswer: They always lose because they have no team spirit.
references: They always lose because they have no team spirit.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: lose 作不及物动词“输”；“团队精神”= team spirit。

q64.sampleAnswer: The magician is going to perform magic at the party.
references: The magician is going to perform magic at the party.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “魔术师”= magician（magic 的派生词）；“表演魔术”= perform magic；将来用 be going to。

q65.sampleAnswer: Nobody at the lunch table believed the truth of his story.
references: Nobody at the lunch table believed the truth of his story.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “一起吃午餐的人”可译为 at the lunch table；“没有人”= nobody，谓语用单数。

q66.sampleAnswer: The main idea of the paragraph usually appears in the first sentence of the paragraph.
references: The main idea of the paragraph usually appears in the first sentence of the paragraph.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “主要意思”= the main idea；“出现”= appear，主语单数用 appears。

q67.sampleAnswer: Nowadays, many airports use electronic equipment to check the forbidden items in the luggage passengers carry.
references: Nowadays, many airports use electronic equipment to check the forbidden items in the luggage passengers carry.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “行李”= luggage（不可数）；“违禁物品”= forbidden items；passengers carry 是省略关系代词的定语从句。

q68.sampleAnswer: The biggest aim of study is to make students own the ability to conquer difficulties and keep learning instead of changing them into machines that only can handle tests.
references: The biggest aim of study is to make students own the ability to conquer difficulties and keep learning instead of changing them into machines that only can handle tests.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “使某人做”= make sb. do；“而不是”= instead of doing；“把……变成……”= change...into...；machines 用复数。
